## Azure DocumentDB  
  
<!--d96c6930-9713-4f88-ae2a-6bde1c8f1ff4_begin-->

#### Increase storage headroom for your Azure DocumentDB cluster  
  
This cluster is approaching its allocated storage capacity. Review storage growth, remove data that you no longer need, or increase storage to preserve headroom. You can increase storage, but you can't decrease it.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Reduce risk of storage capacity exhaustion  

**Impact:** Medium
  
For more information, see [Scale or configure a cluster](/azure/documentdb/how-to-scale-cluster#increase-storage-size)  

ResourceType: microsoft.documentdb/mongoclusters
